summary: Resolve Home Manager's Linux replication worker unit for supervisor admission

replay.detail: No claim, projection or replay changes.

rules.detail: Replication and consistency rules are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Default-instance Linux service lookup recognizes smalltalk-replication.service alongside the CLI worker names, allowing supervisor PID lookup to find Home Manager's installed or running worker. Smalltalk units remain in the legacy family, and conflicting legacy and Fractal installations are still refused. Named instances and macOS lookup are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime beyond the normal binary restart.

recovery.detail: Binary swap-back requires no data migration.
